method: Two clinic nodes, Melaka and Jasin, were connected to a PostgreSQL cloud node built from migration 002, using the least-privilege role medilink_app through the row-level security policies. A patient was seen at Melaka, then arrived at Jasin. Each check below was made either through the clinics' own interfaces or directly against the database as medilink_app.
rows: Melaka's record reaches the cloud through RLS (as medilink_app)
Melaka pinned: sees its own records
Jasin writes a row labelled as Melaka's
Jasin doctor without consent: told records exist at Melaka
Jasin doctor approves their own access request
After the patient consents: Jasin doctor reads Melaka's record
After the consent expires: records released by the database
